hero.title: Conversation-first websites without collapsing into a chatbot widget.
hero.body: This lane treats chat as the page architecture: prompt seeds, response cards, action rails, and supporting systems all live inside the same manifest-driven shell.

feature_cards.title: Seeded interactions
feature_cards.body: Start with curated prompts instead of an empty text box.

feature_cards.title: Action-aware replies
feature_cards.body: Responses can point users toward docs, sales, portfolios, or live runtime state.

feature_cards.title: Actor-ready backend
feature_cards.body: Chat surfaces can grow into actor-backed route and orchestration flows.

story_cards.title: The whole site is the assistant
story_cards.body: Not just a floating support button bolted onto a landing page.

story_cards.title: Keep the conversation data-driven
story_cards.body: Prompts and responses belong in manifests, not in opaque browser code.

timeline.title: Curate strong starting prompts
timeline.body: Guide the first interaction so the page teaches itself quickly.

timeline.title: Connect prompts to systems
timeline.body: Tie conversation into docs, products, portfolio, or route layers.

timeline.title: Swap in actor-backed responses
timeline.body: Use the same shell when the backend moves beyond static seeds.

chat_seed.text: Tell me what kind of site you want and I will route you to the right launch stack.
I can sketch a business homepage, a 3D campaign shell, or an actor-server dashboard.

actor_roles.name: prompt_router
actor_roles.responsibility: Matches user intent to the right site experience.

actor_roles.name: response_writer
actor_roles.responsibility: Builds next actions and summary cards.

server_routes.purpose: returns starter chat payloads and seed messages

cta.title: Start from a conversation, not a sitemap.
cta.body: Use the chat lane when prompt flow is the product surface.
